profile.headline: Software developer with hands-on React.js experience and a working knowledge of financial markets.
profile.about: I'm a software developer focused on React.js and frontend development. I worked as a Software Developer Intern at UNICO International (July – December 2025), building the company website in React.js, and in technical support at Quod Soft India, Kochi (April – August 2026). I have a working knowledge of financial markets, trading fundamentals and fintech concepts, and I manage and lead activities across VFUTURES and Enroute UAE, coordinating operations, social media and lead generation.
